claims.text: OpenTofu loads all .tf files of one folder as one configuration; splitting it across several files in that folder does not change its meaning.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Language > Files and Directories (File extension; Directories and modules)

claims.text: A resource block has a resource type and a local name (resource "kind_cluster" "this"); the pair is the address kind_cluster.this; arguments such as name and node_image, and what they mean, are defined by the provider for its type, not by OpenTofu.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Language > Resources > Resource Blocks (Resource Syntax: "Most arguments in this section depend on the resource type")

claims.text: OpenTofu relies on plugins called providers, distributed separately, to interact with remote systems; each resource type is implemented by a provider; OpenTofu's own program has no resource type for kind (kind_cluster) or for the other systems you manage with it.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Language > Providers (what providers do); Resources > Resource Blocks (each resource type is implemented by a provider)

claims.text: tehcyx/kind supplies kind_cluster, which creates a kind cluster through the local Docker engine (arguments name, node_image, wait_for_ready, kind_config; kind_config takes kind config file settings such as kind, api_version, node); kind runs each node as one Docker container.
claims.source_hint: search.opentofu.org provider tehcyx/kind 0.11.0: Resources > kind_cluster; kind.sigs.k8s.io Quick Start (nodes as Docker containers)

claims.text: required_providers (terraform block) maps a provider local name, chosen there and separate from a resource's local name, to a source and version constraint; by default a type's first word before an underscore is the provider local name; tofu init installs a match into .terraform.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Provider Requirements (required_providers, local names); Resources > Resource Blocks (provider meta-argument: default from type prefix); CLI > tofu init

claims.text: A source address is [hostname/]namespace/type; the namespace (tehcyx) is the publishing account in the registry; without a hostname it means registry.opentofu.org, which serves providers by source and version; the stage-3 lock file records registry.opentofu.org/tehcyx/kind.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Provider Requirements (Source Addresses, default hostname); examples/don-hang deploy/tofu/lessons/first-cluster/.terraform.lock.hcl at stage-3 line 4

claims.text: tofu init writes .terraform.lock.hcl, in the configuration folder beside (not inside) .terraform, with the exact version selected for each provider and checksums of its packages; the file is meant to be committed; .terraform/ is git-ignored in Đơn Hàng.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Language > Dependency Lock File (Lock File Location; Checksum verification); examples/don-hang .gitignore at stage-3 ('.terraform/')

claims.text: When .terraform.lock.hcl lists a provider, tofu init installs the recorded version rather than the newest match, and rejects a package whose checksum is not in the recorded hashes; tofu init -upgrade selects again, the newest version within the constraint, and updates the lock file.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Dependency Lock File (Dependency Installation Behavior; Checksum verification); CLI > tofu init (-upgrade)

claims.text: Without a recorded selection, tofu init chooses the newest available provider version that satisfies the version constraint.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: Dependency Lock File (Dependency Installation Behavior: new dependency); Version Constraints

claims.text: tofu validate checks configuration syntax, references between blocks and argument types (using provider schemas) without accessing remote services such as the Docker engine; it requires an initialized working directory with the providers installed, so it fails before tofu init.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs v1.10: CLI > tofu validate (does not access remote services; requires initialized working directory)

claims.text: The terraform block configures OpenTofu itself; required_version constrains the OpenTofu CLI version; ~> 1.10.0 lets only the right-most component grow (1.10.0 and later 1.10.x, not 1.11.0); a bare "0.11.0" allows exactly that version.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs v1.10: Language > Settings (terraform block, required_version); Expressions > Version Constraints (~>, = implied)

claims.text: tofu-first-cluster.sh@stage-3: line 6 defines show() (prints '$ ' and the command, then runs it); lines 8-17 delete .terraform, run tofu init, fmt -check, validate; output shows init reusing tehcyx/kind from the lock file, installing v0.11.0, and 'Success!'.
tofu fmt -check prints nothing and exits 0 when every file is already in canonical format; otherwise it lists the files that need formatting and exits non-zero.

ci.yml@stage-3 job iac installs OpenTofu 1.10.10, runs tofu fmt -check -recursive deploy/tofu, then init -backend=false and validate in each folder with .tf files outside modules/ (deploy/tofu/lessons/*, deploy/tofu/envs/*/*); no step creates a cluster.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang .github/workflows/ci.yml at stage-3, job iac (working tree lines 399-435)

claims.text: Try it: after tofu init, tofu validate prints 'Success! The configuration is valid.'; with the type changed to kind_clustr it fails, since no provider of the folder supplies that type; no cluster is created.
claims.source_hint: outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-first-cluster.txt line 22; opentofu.org docs CLI tofu validate; kind_clustr error not yet observed: run once in first-cluster

claims.text: Passing tofu validate does not show that the cluster can be created: failures that need the real system, such as the Docker engine not running, appear only later, when OpenTofu asks the provider to create the object.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: CLI > tofu validate (validation only, no remote services); tofu apply

claims.text: tofu init -input=false fails instead of asking for input when input is needed; -no-color disables colour in the output; with no backend block OpenTofu uses the default local backend, and init prints 'Initializing the backend...' for it.
claims.source_hint: opentofu.org docs: CLI > tofu init (general options -input, -no-color); Language > Settings > Backends > Configuration (default local backend); outputs/stage-3/scripts/devops/tofu-first-cluster.txt
